findings.source_quote: “one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “ohne euren Vater zu Boden” with “zu Boden, ohne dass euer Vater es weiß” to convey the Father’s awareness, rather than suggesting the bird falls in the Father’s absence.
findings.translation_quote: “Und doch fällt keiner von ihnen ohne euren Vater zu Boden”

findings.source_quote: “His delight is not merely in the sophisticated and prospering”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “den Gebildeten und Wohlhabenden” with “den Anspruchsvollen und Erfolgreichen” to preserve the contrast with those who are considered successful or prosperous.
findings.translation_quote: “Sein Wohlgefallen gilt nicht nur den Gebildeten und Wohlhabenden”

findings.suggested_fix: Use a natural German heading such as “…die Späteren” (or another contextually suitable rendering) instead of the awkward standalone “…Späteren”.
